description: Lucene-style full-text search across the entire SEC EDGAR public-filings corpus since the 1990s. Forms include 10-K (annual), 10-Q (quarterly), 8-K (current event), DEF 14A (proxy), S-1 (IPO), 13F (institutional holdings), and ~70+ others. License: US Government public domain. The killer endpoint for finance and equity-research agents.
name: search_sec_edgar
